A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the existence of a regulatory protein that is required for the induction of the arabinose operon.
we have determined the nucleotide sequence for the entire araC gene from E. coli K-12.
the ara C gene from strain B/r is 97% identical to the K-12 gene.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can’t just assume that a protein is going to fold the same way in every organism.
the amino acid sequence of ara C regulatory protein is conserved, whereas the nucleotide sequence is not.
, in general, the amino acid sequence of a gene is much more conserved than the DNA sequence.
